question: Approve the design and enter implementation? Approving accepts Decision 1 (the check runs in the validation-time dispatch_records.py folder run only) and Decision 2 (only the first implementation record of the stage is checked), each as recommended. It also accepts the batch-1 implementation order (names-check-before-dispatch lands before extension-instruction-reaches-dispatch, which edits the same dispatch_records.py function; the other three run in parallel), and is the grant for the implementation worker to push a branch and open a Draft PR.
